Your strongest fit is   Option A — Footscray  . It meets every hard requirement:   under AUD 650/week  ,   2 bedrooms  ,   under 40 minutes to the CBD by train  , and includes   laundry  , with the added bonus of a   balcony   that may help with natural light.

1) Footscray — Best overall
-   Why it ranks first:   It is the   only option that cleanly satisfies all major constraints  .
-   Budget:   AUD 610/week, comfortably below your cap.
-   Layout:   True   2-bedroom  .
-   Commute:   32 minutes by train, within your 40-minute limit.
-   Preferences:   Has   laundry   and   balcony  , which supports your natural-light preference.
2) Box Hill — Best cheaper alternative
-   Why it ranks second:   Strong on price and still meets bedroom and commute requirements.
-   Tradeoff:     No laundry  , which is one of your stated preferences.
-   Upside:   At   AUD 590/week  , it is the cheapest true 2-bedroom option and includes a balcony.
3) Brunswick — Best lifestyle/commute trade-off
-   Why it ranks third:   Excellent commute at   24 minutes   and includes laundry.
-   Tradeoff:   It is   AUD 20/week over budget  , which breaks a hard constraint unless you're willing to stretch.
-   Also note:   No balcony, so it gives less evidence of natural light than A.
4) Coburg — Best near-match if flexible on bedroom type
-   Why it ranks fourth:   Good price, commute, laundry, and balcony.
-   Tradeoff:   It is   not a true 2-bedroom  ; a   1 bed + study   may work for some renters, but it does not fully match your requirement.
-   When it works:   Only if you're open to using the study as a second sleeping/work space.
Tradeoff Assessment by Priority
Given your priorities, the decision order is clear:
-   Hard constraints first:   budget, 2 bedrooms, under-40-minute train commute, move-in by 2026-08-01
-   Preferences next:   laundry and natural light
Option A wins   because it satisfies the hard constraints and both preferences best from the details provided.
Best alternatives depending on flexibility:
- If you want to   save the most money   and can live without laundry:   Option C
- If you can   stretch budget   for a faster commute:   Option B
- If you can   compromise on bedroom count/layout  :   Option D
Search Context Used
I treated these as the key decision rules:
-   Must have:   max   AUD 650/week  ,   2 bedrooms  ,   < 40 min train commute
-   Nice to have:     laundry   and signs of   natural light
-   Move-in by 2026-08-01:   no listing-specific availability data was provided, so ranking is based on the property features and constraints only.
